commit_sha_convention: Points to the final watcher implementation commit; the handoff metadata and README follow in a reporting commit to avoid a self-referential SHA.
actual_changes: Completion now requires Codex exit code 0 plus a post-run GPT_HANDOFF whose phase matches the authorized phase and whose status is completed.
Non-zero exits, post-run sync failures, and missing or mismatched handoffs clear the launched marker, persist failure details, and become retryable after a five-minute local backoff.
Verified completed fingerprints remain duplicate-skipped; legacy state files gain the new failure fields without migration tooling.
critical_boundaries_preserved: Single-run file lock, clean-worktree check, fetch plus fast-forward-only synchronization, workspace-write sandbox, and on-request approval remain intact.
P2A-2R was not executed; no database, schema, data, image, cloud-runner, dependency, or approval-policy changes were made.
tests_or_checks: Focused coverage includes zero exit without matching handoff, non-zero exit, matching completed handoff, retry after expired backoff, duplicate completed fingerprint, lock safety, and dirty-worktree safety.
risks_or_blockers: The five-minute retry interval is fixed in watcher.ps1 and uses the local machine UTC clock.

A successful run whose handoff is not visible after post-run sync is intentionally retried rather than treated as complete. Existing matching completion evidence is recognized before launch to prevent a duplicate retry after an interrupted verification cycle.
next_minimum_action: Wait for a new task. Do not restore or execute P2A-2R automatically.
